messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: GPU autoscaler alert for cluster-prod-1 — unable to attach instance profile during nodegroup create, pending pods piling on infer-queue (>1200). Triggered 2025-03-16T14:00:22Z.
ops-oncall: I'm on call, looking now. @sre-alex on standby. :thumbsup:
sre-alex: seeing repeated errors from cloudprovider when creating nodes: `Error: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole` on CreateAutoScalingGroup. snippet:
```
2025-03-16T14:00:18Z ERROR aws: CreateAutoScalingGroup failed: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-eks-controller/... is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-gpu-role-v4
```
eng-jordan: we rotated instance-profile last night as part of credential hardening. Could be the new profile name isn't referenced in the launch template. @ops-oncall can you check LT config?
ops-oncall: pull from cluster — LT shows `InstanceProfile: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/redwood-gpu-role-v3` (old). the rotation created `redwood-gpu-role-v4`. autoscaler seems to request v4 but LT pins v3 -> mismatch causing attach/permission failures.
prod-beth: customer impact: Dedicated inference customers on prod-us-east reported 504s and queued requests. Spike: 99th latency from 240ms -> 2.1s, error-rate increased ~5.9% for the last 10m. Link to dashboard: https://grafana.example/redwood/ops-cluster-prod (internal).
sre-alex: confirm that autoscaler will attempt to create nodegroup with new profile, but LT override to v3 prevents bootstrapping. Two mitigation paths: 1) update LT to v4 and force scale, 2) manually create a temporary nodegroup with v4 profile. Manual is fastest.
eng-jordan: I can do LT update but prefer to avoid mass rollout during traffic spike. Recommend manual nodegroup creation as hotfix, then update LT with careful canary.
ops-oncall: creating nodegroup with correct profile now. running:
```bash
eksctl create nodegroup --cluster prod-cluster --name ng-gpu-hotfix-1 
  --node-type p4d.24xlarge --node-ami auto --node-iam-instance-profile redwood-gpu-role-v4 --node-volume-size 200
```
(creating...)
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by ops-oncall. Est. TTR 35m. Paging policy: full SRE follow-up requested. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sre-alex: manual nodegroup creation succeeded, nodes are registering. `kubectl get nodes` shows 6 new Ready GPU nodes. Autoscaler detected capacity and resumed normal provisioning logic. Pending pods are scheduling.
ops-oncall: traffic rerouted, queue length dropping: infer-queue ~420 -> 95 in 12m. throttling cleared.
prod-beth: metrics: error-rate back to 0.04%, 99p latency 260ms. Customer impact appears mitigated. Initiating customer notifications for affected tenants.
eng-jordan: follow-up plan: 1) update launch template to reference `redwood-gpu-role-v4` (canary on cluster-prod-canary), 2) add validation in rotation playbook to patch LTs and nodegroup templates, 3) add test that simulates nodegroup create after rotation. I'll own LT rollout.
sre-alex: I'll audit autoscaler permissions and add a check that compares LT instance-profile vs expected post-rotation. Also will add a runbook entry for hotfix nodegroup creation.
ops-oncall: opening incident ticket INC-20250316-01 with timeline and commands used. We'll also tag the rotation PR and revert if needed. Closing pager for now. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: Pager closed by ops-oncall. If issues recur open INC-20250316-01.
prod-beth: will write a short incident summary for all-hands and coordinate postmortem with Eng/Infra.
eng-jordan: noted. I'll schedule LT canary this week and link to the incident doc.
sre-alex: assigning action items: (eng-jordan) LT update + canary, (sre-alex) autoscaler permission audit, (ops) rotation playbook update.
ops-oncall: thanks team — great coordination. Closing thread. :sparkles:
